annotations.title: See what would leave if a film were shared

description: Shows what sharing a film (or, with as: piece, one of the user's pieces of « Mes pièces ») with everybody would send, and writes nothing: a picture drawn from what would leave (as a template: the film without its brand, its logo or its pictures, and with words: false without the texts its author wrote; as a style: its colours and type on a film of ours), what leaves and what stays, the texts that would leave, the closest template already in the library (one more than two thirds the same is refused as a copy), and the permission the person gives by sharing. Online, share_url opens the editor's share window for this film: the person names the share, ticks the permission and shares, themselves; a person of the Cutscene team checks it within 3 days. You never share in their place.

as.description: template: the whole film, as a film others start from (two shots at least); style: its colours and type alone; piece: one of the user's pieces, on its own

name.description: The film's name (see list_films); with as: piece, the id of one of the user's pieces (search_library { mine: true })

words.description: A template only. false: the texts its author wrote stay behind (the library's examples take their place). Default true: they leave as example words
